posts.author: rata
posts.body:
Hi there! I was wondering if there's a way to edit Ossra's BasicShadow plugin so that it affects every sprite on the map? Currently it only affects the character, events and vehicles, and it would be cool if all other sprites placed (decoration, such as buildings or trees) could also cast a shadow. Doesn't need to be dynamic or anything, the plugin works fantastic as it is, I'd just like it to affect more than events.
Link to original plugin:
BasicShadows by Ossra

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
Well, I think you'll probably find that "every sprite on the map" isn't actually what you want at all. For example: animated waterfall effects are often among those sprites, and you certainly wouldn't want them to cast shadows.
And it also sounds like you're asking for tiles to cast shadows, which is a
really
big ask.

posts.author: Aerosys
posts.body:
I just briefly scanned the code, and that would be more complicated than a simple request. And it will very likely impact your game's performance when every impassable tile renders a shadow.
Or, what
exactly
should also throw shadows besides the player and events?

Mostly was thinking about buildings, trees, some clutter... statues or pillars for example, maybe signs or fences. I've seen a couple plugins that do this, but they're for MZ sadly. They also use dynamic shadows which I don't really need, I'm happy just setting a default angle for all of them.
